Ubiquiti UniFi U6-Pro – 5.3 Gbps WiFi 6 Access Point for Ultra-Fast Connectivity

The Ubiquiti UniFi U6-Pro is a powerful WiFi 6 (802.11ax) access point, delivering blazing-fast speeds up to 5.3 Gbps for seamless, high-performance wireless networking. Ideal for businesses, offices, hotels, cafes, and high-density environments, the U6-Pro ensures low-latency, high-speed, and reliable connectivity with MU-MIMO and OFDMA technology.

Key Features:

  • Ultra-Fast 5.3 Gbps WiFi 6 Speeds – Supports 4x4 MIMO for faster and more efficient connections
  • Dual-Band Connectivity – Up to 600 Mbps (2.4GHz) + 4.8 Gbps (5GHz) for maximum performance
  • Advanced OFDMA & MU-MIMO – Handles multiple devices simultaneously without slowdowns
  • Seamless Integration with UniFi Network – Easily managed via the UniFi Network Application
  • Compact, Weather-Resistant Design – Suitable for indoor and semi-outdoor use
  • PoE+ Support (802.3at) – Simplified installation with Power over Ethernet


Upgrade your network with the UniFi U6-Pro and experience next-level speed, security, and scalability.
